facts.fact: Saskia 从碗里抓了钥匙冲出门，直奔 Lucy 家，跑上旋转楼梯。
facts.anchor: Saskia plucks her key from the bowl and bolts outside.

facts.fact: Saskia 站在月光照着的公寓里查看：没有强行进入的痕迹，没有血迹，也没有东西着火。
facts.anchor: There was no sign of forced entry. There is no blood. Nothing is on fire.

facts.fact: Lucy 穿着睡衣站在浴室洗手台前，对 Saskia 说公寓里进过一个男人。
facts.anchor: “There was a man in my apartment.”

facts.fact: Lucy 说那男人肚子被捅了，抓住她、朝她脸上咳血，她一回头人就不见了。
facts.anchor: He—he was stabbed. In the stomach. He grabbed me and coughed blood in my face, and when I turned back, he was gone.

facts.fact: Saskia 抱着 Lucy，低声告诉她那只是一个梦。
facts.anchor: “It was just a dream,” she murmurs.

facts.fact: Saskia 明知自己不该贴这么近，却必须让 Lucy 相信那只是梦。
facts.anchor: She is not supposed to get this close to Lucy, but she has to convince Lucy that it was a dream.

facts.fact: 她打算事后再收拾善后，而且她一向如此。
facts.anchor: She’ll take care of the aftermath later. She always does.

facts.fact: Saskia 讲自己从小就有夜惊：门开一条缝，一个拿刀的老妇人站在那里。
facts.anchor: there’s an old woman standing there with a knife

facts.fact: Saskia 翻身仰躺、把 Lucy 拉到身上，两只手就都空出来了。
facts.anchor: Saskia rolls onto her back, pulling Lucy on top of her.

facts.fact: 结尾她要用这个夜晚让 Lucy 除了星星什么都看不见。
facts.anchor: She will make Lucy see nothing but stars.
